findings.summary: The inventory of what the volume did was reduced and lost the final part's account of itself.

evidence.baseline: And in its final part, it has turned from what Providence must not become to what it could become if it is built well: presence understood as infrastructure rather than private virtue; the first Scale standing on real ground in a real place; and the long vision of a civilization that coordinates the way living systems coordinate, sovereign communities made coherent without being made identical, Scale by Scale, until the architecture is no longer a design but a living body awakening to itself.
evidence.shipped: It proposes a sequence, names economic and governance constraints, outlines technical requirements, describes the human capacities the work would consume, and tests the design through composite scenes.

findings.diagnosis: The closing chapter's job is to say what the book did, and the shipped version omits Part VIII entirely. A reader who has just finished the dragon chapter is told the volume proposed a sequence and tested it in scenes. The three-part summary of Part VIII is also the last statement of the volume's turn from constraint to possibility.

findings.summary: The Volume V account was reduced and the closing cadence flattened.

evidence.baseline: Volume V will need to be a book of encounter: what the architecture produced in contact with reality, what was learned that the maps could not show, what the series got right and what it got wrong. ... That is where this volume ends. Not with a conclusion, because the argument is not concluded. Not with a promise, because the outcomes are not known. But with the architecture in hand, the invitation extended, and the work ahead.
evidence.shipped: Volume V turns from institutional architecture toward human purpose and the people who might build. ... This volume ends with proposals in hand, evidence still owed, and the invitation to test the difference.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, and CTD-0034 read onto the Volume V promise.
findings.diagnosis: The shipped close is good and its evidence still owed is a real improvement, kept in the restoration. What went is the two-denial cadence, not a conclusion and not a promise, which is the volume's last refusal and the exact structure the corpus's other closings use. A book of encounter is also the specific promise CTD-0034 tracks, and stating it plainly serves the item better than replacing it with a topic.

reasoning.note: R-PUNCT-STRUCT. Four em dashes. Three were parenthetical appositives and became comma pairs. One introduced the specification of what the building involves and became a comma.

The shipped inventory of what has not been done, naming the governance architecture, the application, the first Scale, the Currency of Presence, the safeguards, and the population ranges, and the shipped statement that the Cardinal Scale is design fiction whose events do not establish implementation. Both are CTD-0072 and CTD-0030 paydowns and neither is in the baseline.
The shipped paragraph naming the volume's strongest contribution as an inventory of obligations, and the shipped warning that Volume V should not be presented as an implementation report.
The shipped label What Remains Unbuilt, which holds the route. The label was not touched.
The Part VIII summary, the account of what the building is and who does it, the book of encounter formulation, and the two-denial close.

openQuestions: The baseline label An Honest Accounting names the chapter's posture and the current label What Remains Unbuilt names its content. The current label holds the route and is better aligned with CTD-0072. The rename costs the reader the sense that the chapter accounts for both sides of the ledger, which the restored prose carries instead. The labels were not touched.

The volume-04 voice card was prepared by the same pass that produced the shipped text, and its exemplar anchors and protected lines quote that text rather than the baseline. The card records `Author approved: pending tone, strategy, heading, and overcompression review`. The restoration keeps every line the card protects and otherwise follows the baseline, which means card and source now diverge in wording the card does not name. R-VOICE-BIND requires that the disagreement be raised rather than settled here: the card should be re-derived from whichever text the author approves.

Structural labels were frozen for this pass and none was touched. Every markdown heading, every standalone bold display line, every chapter label, and every all-capital display line is byte identical to its pre-edit state, in the same order, with the same blank-line separators on both sides. A label determines a section id, a section id is a public route, and `publishing/continuity/section-lineage.json` already records this volume's renames and resolves the historical routes. Changing one is a continuity decision and not an editorial one. Only the running prose between labels was restored. Where a baseline label names its section better than the current one, the cost is recorded here and the label is left alone.

regenerationTest.purpose: The rules must reproduce the section from the baseline without consulting the shipped text.
regenerationTest.method: Derived from the immutable baseline applying editorial/method/standard.md, the corpus voice card, the volume-04 voice card, and the debt ledger under R-LEDGER-WINS.
regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. The closing chapter is the one place where the shipped text was substantially better than the baseline on the ledger's own terms, and the restoration is mostly additive: the shipped inventory of what remains unbuilt is kept whole and the baseline's account of what was done and how the volume ends is restored around it. Eighty-nine sections in, that is the shape the whole re-render converged on, and it is the answer to the question this record set exists to ask: the prior pass was not wrong to add. It was wrong to pay for every addition with an argument.

audits.auditor: editorial-agent, Volume IV close-out and adversarial verification lane
audits.scope: First standardAudit for this record. Full re-read of the current section against the immutable baseline under all twenty rules, run under the baseline-prepared volume card adopted 2026-07-31 (CTD-0110) and after the 2026-07-31 resolution of CTD-0030. The original record was derived under the thirteen-rule index; this audit adds the substitution count and the later rules: R-LEDGER-WINS-COROLLARY, R-CORRECTION-SCOPE, R-CANON-DELETION-RECORD, R-PAIRED-DELETION, R-CAUTIOUS-HALF, R-SUBSTITUTION-CREDIT, and R-REFRAIN-COST.

substitutionTest.rule: R-CAUTIOUS-HALF, substitution form, run as standing procedure before any pairing test
substitutionTest.method: Normalize both texts, strip markup, split into sentences of three or more words, count baseline sentences appearing verbatim in the current section.
substitutionTest.note: Well above zero, so the pairing test applies. Every non-surviving baseline sentence was attributed: the em dash repairs, the CTD-0072 conversion of made the governance architecture operational to proposed governance mechanisms specific enough to be argued with, the kept expansion of what has not been done naming the application, the first Scale, the Currency of Presence, the safeguards, and the population ranges, the kept strongest-contribution paragraph and implementation-report warning, and the closing conversion of the architecture in hand to proposals in hand, evidence still owed, all recorded in the generation notes.

audits.checked: R-LEDGER-WINS, re-run: CTD-0072 remains open and the proposed-mechanisms language still pays it down; restoring the baseline's operational claim would reopen it against the resolved CTD-0030 as well. CTD-0034's Volume V conditional stands in the Volume-V-if-it-exists form. R-CAUTIOUS-HALF, structural form: heading pair re-confirmed, baseline An Honest Accounting against current What Remains Unbuilt, already adjudicated in this record's open questions; the route holds and the restored prose delivers the baseline heading's posture in its first sentence, attempted with rigor and honesty. CTD-0075 re-checked against the restored Volume III of 2026-07-31: the current Volume III, restored to its eight-part shape, still contains no section named The Deeper Inquiry or What Remains Open and no opening statement that almost nothing had been built, so this volume's self-descriptions remain accurate against the restored reality and the paydown stands; the phantom-apparatus lines this item names are handled in the opening chapters' records. CTD-0047 re-checked against the restored Volume III, which promises the construction volume at full strength at least six times: economics built out with the rigor the subject demands, the precise cryptographic, legal, and federated mechanisms by which crossing is made impossible, specification at the level a builder could act on, the full construction plan in full and practical detail, the detailed economic architecture with pricing and capitalization pathways, and construction sequenced, governed, capitalized. The baseline of this section already concedes the volume has not built anything, and the current text widens the concession under CTD-0072; the specific promises Volume IV meets at named-mechanism level are sequencing, governance, commons, and capture analysis, while unit economics, pricing, capitalization pathways, and enforcement mechanisms that make crossing impossible are deferred onward, the measurement chapter deferring its own mechanism to the volumes still to come. Flagged against CTD-0047 with these facts; not reconciled, per the standing instruction. R-PAIRED-DELETION: map and ground, book of encounter, Chapter Twenty-Two swept two-ended; the invitation chapter carries the other end of Chapter Twenty-Two and stands. R-CORRECTION-SCOPE: the CTD-0072 conversion verified at width, the operational clause alone. R-LEDGER-WINS-COROLLARY: nothing seeded. R-SUBSTITUTION-CREDIT: the kept expansions are ledger-authorized keeps under CTD-0072 and CTD-0030, not merit keeps; stated explicitly, no credit owed. R-REFRAIN-COST, R-TENSE, R-DEIXIS, R-NEGATION-STACK: the closing not-with-a-conclusion, not-with-a-promise pair is the baseline's own figure with both rejected alternatives real; retention limb holds, nothing fires.
audits.conclusion: Nothing fires. Eighteen of twenty-seven baseline sentences survive verbatim; the remainder is attributed in full to CTD-0072, the resolved CTD-0030, and glyph repairs. CTD-0075 and CTD-0047 are flagged with current facts against the restored Volume III; both remain the author's.
